LINDBAEK-NILSSON

Extract from H.O. file L.1675.

Minutes.

The appropriate files (H.2807 for HODANN and N.904 for NILSSON) are now attached. Unfortunately HODANN will presumably have left U.K. by now for Brussels.

Index to M.I.5. for observations.

(signed) T.B.W.
29.4.35.

Home Office.

As far as Lise LINDBAEK is concerned we do not feel that we can object to an extension.

With regard to Max HODANN we think that his employment as amanuensis to Lise LINDBAEK is merely an excuse to remain here.

As a refugee who may turn out to be highly undesirable, we are not anxious that he should settle down permanently in this country. We should not, however, object to his being granted a short extension at the conclusion of which we should be glad to have the opportunity of submitting further observations.

M.I.5.
30.4.35.

[Original filed in DI=43824]

LINDBAEK-NILSSON

Extract from H.O. file L.1675.

Minutes.

The relevant files (H.2807 for HODANN and N.904 for NILSSON) are now attached. Unfortunately, it appears that HODANN has likely departed the U.K. for Brussels.

Index to M.I.5. for observations.

(signed) T.B.W.
29.4.35.

Home Office.

Regarding Lise LINDBAEK, we do not object to an extension of her stay.

With regard to Max HODANN, we believe that his role as assistant to Lise LINDBAEK is merely a pretext for him to remain in the country.

As a refugee who may prove to be highly undesirable, we are not concerned with his permanent settlement here. However, we would not object to granting him a short extension, after which we would be pleased to submit further observations.

M.I.5.
30.4.35.
